name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.8

  • Prevents bulk-pricing dollar amounts from overlapping on tablets and phones.
  • Narrow viewports now preserve readable price-column widths and use controlled horizontal scrolling instead of compressing currency values.
  • Keeps the Decoration method column visible while customers swipe across quantity tiers.
  • Uses tabular numerals for cleaner price alignment.
  • Migrates ASBO's built-in update manifest to All-Star-Embroidery/asbo-releases.
  • No customer prices, quantity thresholds, Supplier Sync logic, cart calculations, savings, artwork, or checkout behavior changed.
